title: Fable 5 enables software cloning, audits, agentic OS, code #fable5 #modelpricing #aidevelopment
description: Fable 5 demonstrated powerful use cases for software cloning, usage audits, agentic operating systems, code review, and complex project development. It allows users to recreate software locally with full customization, analyze past sessions for skill and automation improvements, and transform daily tasks into automated workflows. The model's capability to support intricate browser-based projects, such as high-quality games, showcases its potential to empower developers beyond existing solutions.
